role: Deterministic graph-based procedure execution engine implementing the three-step lookup core of the Procedural Knowledge Graph.
detail: ProcedureExecutor executes ProceduralTemplate procedures via depth-first AST traversal without LLM calls (Layer 3 infrastructure). The three-step process: (1) Instance check queries COMPUTES_TO edges for existing results above retrieval_threshold and returns immediately with strategy='direct_recall' if found, (2) AST execution traverses procedure body by evaluating step types (literal, variable, operation, conditional, call) with memoization and recursion depth limiting, and (3) Result storage creates or updates COMPUTES_TO edges with initial confidence=0.15 and integrates optional contradiction detection (PKG-3.4). Key constants: _EXECUTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5.0, RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD=0.50 (default), BASE_PROCEDURAL, PROCEDURAL_CAP, BASE_GUARDIAN_CONFIRMED. Supports inter-procedure invocation via 'call' step type with cycle detection (cross-procedure cycles forbidden; self-recursion allowed) and circular-call prevention via call_stack tracking. _ExecutionContext threads deadline, remaining_depth, memoization dict, and call_stack through recursive _execute_ast() invocations. On deadline exceed raises _DeadlineExceededError (internal only, converted to ExecutionTimeoutError). Non-storable results (lists) skip COMPUTES_TO edge creation. Contradiction detection (if wired) delegates conflict handling to external detector on result mismatch.
gotchas: Syntactic step_types (match_root, match_edge, match_optional, extract_role, match_property) raise NotImplementedError — require SyntacticTemplateMatcher (P1.7-E4). Self-recursion allowed but bounded by remaining_depth; cross-procedure cycles strictly forbidden. Non-storable result types skip COMPUTES_TO edge entirely (transient node_id only). Division-by-zero and operand type mismatches raise specific exceptions. Contradiction detector is typed as 'object' to avoid circular imports but expects ContradictionDetector at runtime.
